# Joseph

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) (relative), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Joseph is distinguished by his coat of many colors.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)_

## Personality

Joseph is a meek and inoffensive individual with a sociable, beautiful disposition. Despite his pleasant nature, he is prone to blushing and stuttering whenever he becomes frightened.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P11](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0011), [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)_

## History

Joseph is a cat who belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) that moved to [Vancouver](../codex/places.md#vancouver), and he was named Joseph because his coat was made of many colors. He moved into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and another cat named the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). After an initial adjustment period involving turf wars and squabbles with the resident stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) eventually became close friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), +3 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) are household cats living together at Patty's Place. After an initial adjustment period marked by turf wars and squabbles among the house's pets, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) eventually grows close to Joseph, with the two becoming sworn friends who sleep together and wash each other's faces.
